claymorphism_rules.button_secondary_class: bg-[#8A9A5B] text-white font-bold rounded-[24px] shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(138,154,91,0.3),inset_0_-4px_8px_rgba(50,70,30,0.2),inset_0_4px_8px_rgba(255,255,255,0.6)] transition-transform duration-150 active:translate-y-[2px] active:scale-95
claymorphism_rules.decorations: Use floating decorative clay ornaments (leaves, lotus petals, blob shapes) in the background. Shapes should have similar soft inset shadows.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24 for sections. Containers must have internal padding.
layout.grid: Bento Grid (Mode A) for About/Story section to maintain asymmetry.
layout.hero: Split layout with a large rounded claymorphism container. Include brand name, tagline (heritage + handcrafted goods), and a claymorphism button.
layout.navigation: Sticky top navigation using glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF7F2]/80) combined with a claymorphism cart badge/button.
layout.cart: Persistent floating cart icon with a slide-over drawer (using Shadcn Sheet).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for layout, colors, and claymorphism shadows.
Use custom HTML/Tailwind for product grids, hero section, and about sections.
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactions: Sheet/Drawer for the sliding cart, Dialog for product details modal, and Form for checkout.
Implement a single-page scrolling structure with separate sections for Silk Sarees and Skincare (Garden Glow).
Include a full Stripe checkout flow with a shipping form and Success/Cancel pages.
Add Framer Motion for micro-animations: float, tilt on hover for product cards, and a cart bounce effect.
Provide testing attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Ensure product photography is large, clear, and serves as the visual hero of the product cards.
DO NOT USE TYPESCRIPT. Provide all files in .js / .jsx formats.
